scenarios.title: Accordion
scenarios.description: One section open at a time. Opening another closes it; the open one closes on a click.
scenarios.source:
<sl:accordion name="accordion-demo">
  <sl:accordion-item open>
    <sl:accordion-trigger>Is it accessible?</sl:accordion-trigger>
    <sl:accordion-content>Yes. Each section is a details element, which the browser opens and closes, from the
      keyboard too.</sl:accordion-content>
  </sl:accordion-item>
  <sl:accordion-item>
    <sl:accordion-trigger>Is it styled?</sl:accordion-trigger>
    <sl:accordion-content>Yes. It comes with default styles that match the other components.</sl:accordion-content>
  </sl:accordion-item>
  <sl:accordion-item>
    <sl:accordion-trigger>Is it animated?</sl:accordion-trigger>
    <sl:accordion-content>Yes, where the browser can animate a height to auto, and only when the user has not
      asked for reduced motion.</sl:accordion-content>
  </sl:accordion-item>
</sl:accordion>
scenarios.html:

Is it animated?
Yes, where the browser can animate a height to auto, and only when the user has not asked for reduced motion.

scenarios.title: Toast
scenarios.description: The button sends an sl-toast event; the toaster shows it, and a screen reader announces it.
scenarios.source:

           x-on:click="$dispatch('sl-toast', {title: 'Event has been created', description: 'Monday, January 3rd at 6:00pm'})">

</sl:button>

<sl:toaster id="toaster-default"/>

scenarios.title: Variants
scenarios.description: The variant sets the icon; a screen reader announces an error at once.
scenarios.source:
<sl:button variant="outline" x-data x-on:click="$dispatch('sl-toast', {title: 'Event has been created'})">
  Default
</sl:button>
<sl:button variant="outline" x-data
           x-on:click="$dispatch('sl-toast', {title: 'Event has been created', variant: 'success'})">
  Success
</sl:button>
<sl:button variant="outline" x-data
           x-on:click="$dispatch('sl-toast', {title: 'Be at the area 10 minutes before the event time', variant: 'info'})">
  Info
</sl:button>
<sl:button variant="outline" x-data
           x-on:click="$dispatch('sl-toast', {title: 'Event start time cannot be earlier than 8am', variant: 'warning'})">
  Warning
</sl:button>
<sl:button variant="outline" x-data
           x-on:click="$dispatch('sl-toast', {title: 'Event has not been created', variant: 'error'})">
  Error
</sl:button>
